snippet.title: Deck of Memories - Early Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056570?utm_source=ytteaser

Early Teaser for Deck of Memories.

Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.
